reviews.title: I wasted my money here
reviews.text:
Was hoping this app
Would really help me practice gratitude in an authentic way, instead it feels formulaic and superficial. Don’t get me wrong, some days they really share a great story but on the whole disappointed in the entirety of the offerings. Maybe I have unrealistic expectations that AI shouldn’t permeate every app on the planet - yet here we are.

reviews.title: Best app ever!
reviews.text:
When I stumbled upon this app, I was looking for consistent, daily gratitude reminders. Even though I was practicing everyday, it was challenging to come up with different ways to be grateful and things to be grateful for. The vision board, the daily check ins, the cards and the affirmations after the daily mood check in are my favorite things about this app and there’s so much more. And all features of the app are unlocked for free the first 3 months if you send 3 cards! Amazing! And it has elevated my morning gratitude practice. 
This app is a game changer for me.i have yet to unlock all the perks but the free trial with the cards won me over. No other app that I’ve tried uses a feature like that or offers 3 months of a premium membership for free! Win-win. I use Aura for meditation, Pinterest for inspiration and vision board, Day one for journaling, Motivation & I am for affirmations but this app covers all those features and more. Try it! You will not be disappointed AND no gimmicks or shady business practices. And the developer provided a quick response when I asked about being able to rearrange the vision board and when that feature would be available…within the month they said.  So, we’ll see! P.S. I NEVER wrote reviews…ever.

reviews.title: A powerful toolbox of selfcare!
reviews.text: I am incredibly passionate about this app! I've been using it for 384 days and renewed my subscription today. It was the first step in overcoming my panic attacks. With inspiring daily texts and small tasks, it marks the beginning of a transformative journey of self-discovery. Bon voyage!

reviews.title: Great for youth and adults
reviews.text:
I initially got the app to review for possible use in family based counseling.  It was a wonderful way to offer self based education to families and initiate modeling for parents and bonding between parent and child.  

I continue to use the app for myself as well and would recommend it to anyone.  It is a healthy way to focus on the positives and find your way back if you begin to wonder into negative paths.

reviews.title: Game Changer
reviews.text: Absolutely love this gratitude journal and community. The prompts are so detailed, unique, and thought out. Each day, you are really challenged to look at your life with gratitude in a different context. I look forward to the prompts each day; they are not redundant or generic at all. Responding to the prompts has been eye opening for me, and helps me to start my day off on the right foot. In addition to the prompt, which always gets me thinking in a way I wasn't prepared for, I'm then forced to look for at least three things each day that I'm grateful for, and that always gets my mindset where it needs to be. The community is even better. There is nothing but positivity and good vibes; I love this app!

reviews.title: Make it a habit
reviews.text: There are so many components that promote reflection and positivity. The daily quotes resonate. The writing prompts always have nuggets of wisdom, and while the questions may not always be things I haven’t thought about before, the context can provide a new lens to think about them, and the act of writing about it somehow changes my commitment to change. The affirmations always connect with what I need to hear too. I haven’t gotten too into the community feed yet, but when I used this app in the past, I found it valuable as well. This app is a great tool for personal growth and mindfulness.

reviews.title: Life-Changing, Mental Health App!
reviews.text:
I was recommended 365 Gratitude Journal by the President of my company. I downloaded it out of curiosity and it’s been a healthy change in my life. There’s always new prompts to read daily that are centered around positive life lessons, history, quotes, and self-assessment exercises. 

I use the app whenever I feel my energy is down or as a bonding activity between my partner or my family. It’s helped me improve my positive self-talk and share these lessons with others. I definitely recommend for any age, race, gender, etc.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: I absolutely love this app!! I’ve been using it for a couple of months now and it’s been super easy to stick with. I usually struggle to stick with things like this, but I enjoy this app so much I’ve only missed a few days in 2 months. I got rid of all social medias a few years ago as they are a massively unhealthy waste of time to me. This gratitude app is exactly what I’m looking for; fun, easy to use, promotes self growth, and a much healthier use of my time and energy. The people on here are so kind and it’s really uplifting to be able to receive support in my self growth. I figured if I want to scroll mindlessly I’m my free time, I can look at positive things! My life is so much better with this app and I’ve heard the creator is a really good person too. If you’re thinking about getting this app, do it!! You won’t regret it.
